name: rill-review
description: Find browser recordings, review captured evidence, and draft timestamp-linked bug reports.

defaultPrompt: Review this recording and suggest improvements.
Draft a bug report from this recording.
interface.longDescription: Open your Rill recordings beside chat, inspect a moment and captured diagnostics when available, and draft reports with timestamp links. You can also request recorded browser tasks on public websites using your Rill run credits. A connected Rill account is required.
